grh_8978d6cd330fba6aaadb.title: Dont Trust Your Husband
paragraphs: Advertising man Vince repeatedly comes home late claiming business with a mysterious Mr. Frazier, only for his wife Paula to discover that Frazier is a woman and suspect an affair. Trying to prove that jealousy works both ways, Vince encourages handsome stranger Claude Kimball to flirt with Paula, not realizing Kimball is a wealthy tobacco executive who begins taking the assignment seriously. The scheme escalates into threats of divorce, competing romances and a badly timed confession until the real business client appears and the manufactured jealousy collapses. After one final comic misunderstanding with a hired admirer, Vince and Paula reconcile.

grh_894e3c08e2410c40ae29.title: Old Bones
paragraphs: Two young dirt-bike riders encounter an elderly desert caretaker named Josh, who helps them after one rider badly injures his leg. During the night they hear Josh talking about a buried treasure called Nuggets and assume he has hidden gold nearby. One rider becomes increasingly greedy and violent while the other leaves to get a truck for the injured man. After Josh is bitten by a rattlesnake and dies, the surviving riders dig beside the barrel cactus where he directed them. Instead of gold they uncover the bones of an animal that had been named Nuggets, realizing that Josh's buried treasure was a beloved companion from his past. They bury Josh, mark his grave, and leave the desert with a very different understanding of what he had valued.

grh_89ea73c9acc92c0c9abf.title: The Count of Luxembourg
paragraphs: The penniless Count of Luxembourg accepts a rich duke's offer to marry an unknown woman in a masked ceremony, with the agreement that they will divorce so she can keep the title and marry the duke. Later the count meets opera singer Angèle and they fall in love without realizing they are already husband and wife. The truth comes out just as the arranged divorce is due. paragraphs: A dramatization of John Hersey's A Bell for Adano follows Italian-American Major Victor Joppolo as he administers the newly occupied town of Adano. He works to restore food, water, local government and the carts residents need for daily life, while also pursuing a replacement for the town bell taken away under fascism. Joppolo defies General Marvin's blanket ban on carts because he believes it harms the people and is eventually relieved for disobeying the order, but as he leaves Adano he hears the new bell ringing over the town he tried to serve.

paragraphs: Married couple Henry and Sarah Longstreet look back on their courtship in 1913, when smooth con man Harrison Foy persuaded Sarah's family and neighbors to invest in a worthless real-estate development.
